detail: Benjamin Levy’s nomination describes two stacked square timber stories, 50 ft by 16 ft core, 23 ft west room, 11 ft breezeway, 16 ft east room, two external fireplaces and chimneys, shake roofs and cross-railed porches.
Identifies present Rossville address and the short relocation in the 1960s.
Bishop documents the present and original sites and the rebuilding of the log structure.
Identifies George Barnard’s original nineteenth-century photographic view and corroborates the old porch and large chimney.
